state_basis.subjective_context: Full morning meeting; no CNS symptom was reported.

session.title: Suito recovery-continuity gate
session.purpose: Preserve bike rhythm without borrowing recovery from Tuesday's protected MTB quality session.

dose.opening_gate: 8 minutes at 75-90 W. Continue only if breathing, legs, and mental clarity feel distinctly better rather than merely tolerable.
dose.main: 12-15 minutes at 90-105 W, then 5 minutes at 75-90 W.
dose.cap: 30 minutes absolute maximum, RPE 1-2, natural 75-90 rpm cadence, HR preferably below 120 bpm.
dose.rest_branch: Full rest is a successful alternative if the opening gate is not clearly positive.

session.adaptation_hypothesis: A genuinely low-cost spin can preserve bike-specific continuity and improve circulation while leaving tomorrow's skill acquisition unchanged or better.
execution_rules: Use the Elite Suito in easy resistance or ERG below 105 W.
No tempo, torque, standing work, sprints, cadence drills, or extra time.
The session succeeds by finishing fresher, not by accumulating load.

expected_result.next_day: Readiness and leg freshness are unchanged or improved.

stop_rules: Stop during the opening gate for weak or heavy feel at trivial power, rising RPE, disproportionate HR, headache, dizziness, mental fog, delayed processing, or no clear improvement.
Stop if HR exceeds about 120 bpm at steady easy power or climbs persistently without a power increase.
Do not extend beyond 30 minutes even if the ride feels good.
